titulo: Man arrested at Trump’s California golf course wore earpiece and took photos, police say
cuerpo: Jeanine John Taele faces new weapons charges as details of ‘suspicious’ behavior ahead of president’s visit emerge A California man who was arrested at Donald Trump ’s Los Angeles-area golf course ahead of a presidential visit is facing more charges, as authorities released new details about the investigation. Authorities say federal agents first observed 38-year-old Jeanine John Taele near the golf grounds in Rancho Palos Verdes on 31 July, wearing an earpiece and capturing photographs and videos of security agents assessing the property.
